item.title: Tesla starts paid Cybercab rides
item.description: Tesla has begun offering paid rides in its Cybercab, a two-seat autonomous vehicle built without a steering wheel or brake pedals.

item.title: Next stop, Singapore
item.description: Waymo is bringing its fully autonomous ride-hailing service to Singapore in 2028, and driverless taxis are now much closer to the Philippines than the streets of California where many of us first saw them.
